note: The pipeline's own copy of the licence snapshots. docs/handOff/evidence/ is the frozen archive and is NOT read by any gate; this copy is what the layout gate verifies. Both are deliberate: an archive that must not change and a working copy that a check can fail on.
hashBasis: sha256 of CRLF-normalised bytes, so the check does not encode one machine's line endings
